name: Sandy Springs Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 220 m and 600 m frames) at 38.6048,-83.2822: east-edge pads face a continuous riparian treeline 25-50 m deep along the Ohio River (a buffer, so not riverfront); the southernmost pads look across mostly open grass to the boat ramp and river ~45 m off - river visible, riverview

name: Fireside Lake Campground
evidence: operator site map (2025) + satellite (Esri) at 40.8040,-80.9873: every lakeshore site (A/B/C/D rows) is marked seasonal; the weekend/short-term sites (O/P/WS blocks, Hilltop, R row) sit east of the lake behind the seasonal rows, no water at or in view of a bookable pad - not waterfront for a transient

name: Zion Retreat & RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m and 1.8 km frames) at 40.1578,-81.0675: the main RV loop's east/south-east pads sit ~15-30 m from the north tip of the 27-acre lake across open unused grass (open apron within the ~50 m bound) - lakefront; the west and NW pads back onto smaller ponds through trees
